dct_description_sm:
A Cottage Residential Site is a polygon feature that identifies a site of human occupancy and whether that occupancy is seasonal or year-round.

Different Cottage Residential Site types collected by the Natural Resources Values Information System (NRVIS) include
  • Cottage Site, Not Remote
  • Cottage Site, Remote
  • Residential Site, Not Remote
  • Residential Site, Remote
Additional Time Period Information: Data is collected on an on-going basis therefore the time period 'end date' may be more recent than indicated above.

We are no longer updating this data. It is best suited for historical research and analysis.
